units.title: 占痘疹先察用神旺衰、再究神的动静：用神被生扶拱合则痘长灵根，被克害刑冲则花遭毒雨；用神原神忌神仇神都要分清

rule.yi: 痘、痧、疮、疹是随着六气五行的流转一阵一阵流行的，想问平安还是危险，要凭易卦。先看用神是旺是衰，再考究各爻是动是静：用神被生、扶、拱、合，痘就长得有根；被克、害、刑、冲，花就遭到毒雨。凡占痘痧，一定要先分清用神、原神的衰旺，再考究忌神、仇神的动静。
rule.en: Pox, measles, sores and eruptions come and go with the turning of the six qi and the five phases; to ask whether it will be safe or dangerous one must rely on the hexagram. First look at whether the Subject is strong or weak, then at whether the lines move or are still: if the Subject is generated, supported, embraced or combined, the pox grows a living root; if it is controlled, harmed, punished or clashed, the flowers are struck by poison rain. In all divining of pox and measles one must first tell how strong or weak the Subject and the Support are, then examine how the Adversary and the enemy spirit move or stand still.

zh: 六气司天，寒暑灾祥之感应；
五行迭运，痘痧疮疹之流行。
欲问安危，须凭易卦。
先察用旺衰，次究神动静。
生扶拱合，痘长灵根；
克害刑冲，花遭毒雨。
yi: 六气主宰着天时，寒暑灾祥是它的感应；
五行轮流运转，痘、痧、疮、疹因此流行。
要问平安还是危险，必须凭易卦。
先看用神是旺是衰，再考究各神是动是静。
被生、扶、拱、合，痘就长出有灵气的根；
被克、害、刑、冲，花就遭到毒雨。
en: The six qi rule the heavens, and cold and heat, calamity and omen are their response;
the five phases turn in succession, and pox, measles, sores and eruptions spread by them.
To ask whether it is safe or dangerous, one must rely on the hexagram of the Yi.
First look at whether the Subject is strong or weak, then look into whether the spirits move or are still.
Generated, supported, embraced and combined, the pox grows a living root;
controlled, harmed, punished and clashed, the flowers are struck by poison rain.

zh: 凡卜痘痧，必先分别用神原神衰旺，次究忌神仇神动静。
yi: 凡是占痘痧，一定要先分清用神、原神的衰旺，再考究忌神、仇神的动静。
en: In all divining of pox and measles, one must first tell how strong or weak the Subject and the Support are, then examine how the Adversary and the enemy spirit move or stand still.

note.yi: 这一章是卜筮正宗新增的，不在《黄金策》原书里（卜筮大全和黄金策文件都没有）；赋文和注文的作者，书里没有分别写明，本库把赋文标作本文、把「——」后面的话标作王洪绪注。「痧」这里指跟痘一起流行的出疹的病，书里没有另外解释。「仇神」书里在《原忌仇神论》（卜筮正宗第 971 行）有解释：制克原神、生扶忌神的爻。
note.en: This chapter is an addition of the Bushi Zhengzong and is not in the original Huangjin Ce (neither the Bushi Daquan nor the Huangjin Ce file has it); the book does not say separately who wrote the verse and who the commentary, so the library marks the verse as the base text and what follows the dash as Wang Hongxu's commentary. 'Sha' here means the eruptive illness that spreads along with pox and is not otherwise explained. The 'enemy spirit' (chou shen) is explained in the book's essay on the Support, Adversary and enemy spirit (Bushi Zhengzong, line 971): the line that controls the Support and generates or supports the Adversary.

units.title: 出花的是谁就按谁取用神：兄弟出花以兄弟爻为用神、父母爻为原神；子侄以子孙爻为用神、父动克子是凶；妻奴婢妾以财爻为用神、兄动克财不宜

rule.yi: 看是谁出花来取用神：兄弟出花，拿兄弟爻做用神、父母爻做原神，父母爻发动来生它就吉；子侄出花，拿子孙爻做用神，父母爻发动就克制子孙，是凶，而兄弟爻发动对子侄反而是好的；妻子、奴婢、妾出花，拿财爻做用神，兄弟爻发动克制财爻，也不合适。
rule.en: The Subject is taken by who is having the pox. For a brother, the Peer line is the Subject and the Resource line the Support, and if the Support moves and generates it, it is lucky. For a child or nephew, the Output line is the Subject, and if Resource moves it controls Output, which is unlucky, while a moving Peer is welcome; for a wife, servant, maid or concubine, the Wealth line is the Subject, and a moving Peer controls Wealth, which is likewise unsuitable.

zh: 父动则护持乎兄弟，儿孙安得云宜；
兄兴则为难于妻奴，子侄喜其相遇。
yi: 父母爻发动，就护着兄弟，那么儿孙怎么能说合适呢；
兄弟爻兴旺，就为难妻子、奴婢，而子侄却喜欢碰到它。
en: If Resource moves, it protects and sustains the Peer, so how can it be called suitable for children and grandchildren;
if Peer rises, it makes trouble for wives and servants, while children and nephews are glad to meet it.

zh: 如卜兄弟出花，以兄弟爻为用神，父母爻为原神，动而生之则吉。
倘卜子侄，以子孙爻为用神，父动则克子是凶。
如卜妻奴婢妾，以财爻为用神，兄动则克财，亦不宜也。
凡卜子侄喜遇兄弟动也。
yi: 比如占兄弟出花，拿兄弟爻做用神，父母爻做原神，父母爻发动来生它，就吉。
如果占子侄，拿子孙爻做用神，父母爻发动就克制子孙，是凶。
如果占妻子、奴婢、妾，拿财爻做用神，兄弟爻发动就克制财爻，也不合适。
凡是占子侄，喜欢遇到兄弟爻发动。
en: For example, in divining a brother's pox, the Peer line is the Subject and the Resource line is the Support; if it moves and generates it, it is lucky.
If divining a child or nephew, the Output line is the Subject, and if Resource moves it controls Output, which is unlucky.
If divining a wife, servant, maid or concubine, the Wealth line is the Subject, and if Peer moves it controls Wealth, which is likewise unsuitable.
In all divining of a child or nephew, a moving Peer is welcome.

dispute.yi: 用神取哪一爻：王洪绪按出花的是谁分开取，兄弟取兄弟爻、子侄取子孙爻、妻奴婢妾取财爻，官鬼爻则是痘花本身；增删卜易的野鹤把出花的几件事分开占，问什么时候出花拿鬼爻当用神（LY.ILL.ZS.19），问吉凶大体上全看子孙爻，不管来问的是谁（LY.ILL.ZS.21）。两家取用神的办法不一样，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Which line is the Subject: Wang Hongxu takes it by who has the pox — the Peer line for a brother, the Output line for a child or nephew, the Wealth line for a wife, servant, maid or concubine — and the Pressure line is the pox flowers themselves; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi divides the matters of the pox into separate divinations, taking the Pressure line as the Subject for when the pox will come out (LY.ILL.ZS.19) and looking, on the whole, only at the Output line for fortune, whoever is asking (LY.ILL.ZS.21). The two differ on how the Subject is taken, and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 经文说的是「父动则护持乎兄弟」：父母爻发动，护着兄弟（生兄弟），这对占兄弟出花是好事，但父母爻克子孙，所以对儿孙不合适；兄弟发动克财，所以妻奴受难，而子孙不怕兄弟。
note.en: The verse says 'if Resource moves it protects the Peer': a moving Resource line generates Peer, which is good for a divination about a brother, but Resource controls Output, so it is unsuitable for children and grandchildren; a moving Peer controls Wealth, so wives and servants suffer, while Output has nothing to fear from Peer.

units.title: 最吉者官安用旺、最凶者鬼旺忌兴：官鬼为痘花，不宜伤损也不宜动；遇刑冲克害伏藏是险逆之症，用神旺相而官鬼安静得生扶拱合是顺症

rule.yi: 最吉的是官爻安静、用神旺相，最凶的是鬼爻旺相、忌神兴旺发动。官鬼就是痘花，不适合受到伤损，也不适合发动，动了恐怕会变坏；如果遇到刑、冲、克、害、伏藏这些象，是凶险不顺的症候，即使勉强出得起来，也难以善终；用神旺相、官鬼安静又得到生、扶、拱、合的，是顺症，不用忧虑。
rule.en: Most auspicious is Pressure at rest and the Subject strong; most ominous is Pressure strong and the Adversary rising. The Pressure line is the pox flowers themselves: it should not be harmed and should not move, for if it moves it may turn bad; if it meets punishment, clash, control, harm or hiding, it is a dangerous and adverse condition, and even if it barely erupts it is hard to bring to a good end; if the Subject is strong and the Pressure line is at rest and is generated, supported, embraced or combined, it is a favourable condition and there is nothing to fear.

zh: 最吉者官安用旺，最凶者鬼旺忌兴
yi: 最吉的是官爻安静、用神旺相，最凶的是鬼爻旺相、忌神兴旺发动。
en: Most auspicious is Pressure at rest and the Subject strong; most ominous is Pressure strong and the Adversary rising.

zh: 官鬼为痘花，不宜伤损，亦不宜动，动恐变坏；
如遇刑冲克害伏藏等象，是险逆之症也。
即勉强起发，亦难收成。
用神旺相，官鬼安静而得生扶拱合者，是顺症而无忧虑也。
yi: 官鬼就是痘花，不适合受到伤损，也不适合发动，动了恐怕会变坏；
如果遇到刑、冲、克、害、伏藏这些象，是凶险不顺的症候。
即使勉强出得起来，也难以善终。
用神旺相，官鬼安静又得到生、扶、拱、合的，是顺症，不用忧虑。
en: The Pressure line is the pox flowers; it should not be harmed, nor should it move, for if it moves it may turn bad;
if it meets punishment, clash, control, harm or hiding, it is a dangerous and adverse condition.
Even if it barely erupts, it is hard to bring to a good end.
If the Subject is strong and the Pressure line is at rest and is generated, supported, embraced or combined, it is a favourable condition and there is nothing to fear.

note.yi: 经文的「官安用旺」「鬼旺忌兴」里，「官」「鬼」都是官鬼爻，「用」是用神，「忌」是忌神。「起发」是痘起出来、长起来，「收成」「收功」是痘出完、结好了。
note.en: In the verse's 'Pressure at rest and the Subject strong' and 'Pressure strong and the Adversary rising', 'guan' and 'gui' both mean the Pressure line, 'yong' the Subject and 'ji' the Adversary. 'Erupt' (qifa) is for the pox to come out and grow, and 'completion' (shoucheng, shougong) for the pox to run its course and heal.

units.title: 用得长生百年之内保无虑：用神在日辰上长生、或变出长生，一生都无忧，眼下痘疹更不必虑

rule.yi: 用神在日辰上得长生，或者变出长生，即使一百年之内也没有忧虑，眼下的痘疹又何必担心。
rule.en: If the Subject is born at the Day, or changes into Birth, then even within a hundred years there is nothing to worry about, so why worry now about the pox.

zh: 用得长生，百年之内保无虑
yi: 用神得到长生，一百年之内都保证没有忧虑
en: If the Subject gains Birth, it is guaranteed there is no worry for a hundred years

zh: 用神长生于日辰或化长生者，虽百年之内无忧，目下何必虑之。
yi: 用神在日辰上长生，或者变出长生的，即使一百年之内也没有忧虑，眼下又何必担心呢。
en: If the Subject is born at the Day, or changes into Birth, then even within a hundred years there is nothing to worry about, so why worry now.

note.yi: 「百年之内」是说一辈子，不是真的一百年。经文只说「用」，注写作「用神」。
note.en: 'Within a hundred years' means a whole lifetime, not literally a hundred years. The verse says only 'yong'; the commentary writes it out as the Subject.

units.title: 原临死绝一月之外终有害：用神休囚受伤克又遇原神居死绝，旦夕难延；用神旺相而原神静逢死绝或动化伤克，眼下当令有效，出月退气仍有不测之害

rule.yi: 原神落在死、绝的地方，一个月之外终究有害处：用神休囚又受伤克，再遇上原神落在死、绝之处，一朝一夕都难拖延；用神出现又旺相，而原神安静地遇到死、绝，或者发动却变出伤克的，眼下当令虽然看得到收功，出了这个月、退了气，仍然有想不到的祸害。
rule.en: A Support that falls on Death or Extinction brings harm in the end after a month: if the Subject is resting or trapped and is also harmed and controlled, and the Support meets a place of Death or Extinction, it can hardly last from morning to evening; if the Subject is present and strong but the Support is still and meets Death or Extinction, or moves and changes into harm or control, then for now, in season, one may see it come to completion, but once the month is out and its force retreats there is still an unforeseen harm.

zh: 原临死绝，一月之外终有害
yi: 原神落在死、绝上，一个月之外终究有害
en: A Support that falls on Death or Extinction will in the end bring harm after a month

zh: 如用神休囚再受伤克，又遇原神居于死绝之处，旦夕难延；
若用神出现旺相，而原神静逢死绝，或动化伤克者，目下得令虽见收功，出月退气仍有不测之害也也。
yi: 如果用神休囚，又受到伤克，再遇上原神落在死、绝的地方，一朝一夕都难以拖延；
如果用神出现又旺相，而原神安静地遇到死、绝，或者发动却变出伤克的，眼下当令虽然看得到收功，出了这个月气退了，仍然有想不到的祸害。
en: If the Subject is resting or trapped and is also harmed and controlled, and the Support meets a place of Death or Extinction, it can hardly last from morning to evening;

if the Subject is present and strong, but the Support is still and meets Death or Extinction, or moves and changes into harm or control, then for now, in season, one may see it come to completion, but once the month is out and its force retreats there is still an unforeseen harm.

note.yi: 注里最后有「也也」两个字连着，是原文重复，译文按一个「也」。「得令」是当令、正在旺的月份里。
note.en: The commentary's last words have two 'ye' in a row, a repetition in the text, rendered as one. 'In season' (deling) means in the month when the line is in force.

units.title: 官强而痘难开朗、福旺则花必稀疏：官鬼为痘症宜静不宜动，静而衰痘稀、旺而动痘密；父母为痘花之主亦宜安静有气；福旺官衰则痘花稀朗好收功

rule.yi: 官爻强，痘就难以开朗；福神旺，花一定稀疏。官鬼爻是痘症本身，适合安静、不适合发动，动了就有变化；安静而衰的痘稀，旺而发动的痘密。父母爻是痘花的主，也适合安静有气，最忌讳发动后变出伤克。如果福神旺、官鬼衰，痘花一定稀疏明朗，一定能好好收功。
rule.en: If Pressure is strong the pox will hardly open up clear; if Output is strong the flowers will surely be sparse. The Pressure line is the pox itself; it should be at rest and not move, for if it moves there is change: at rest and weak the pox is sparse, strong and moving the pox is dense. The Resource line is the master of the pox flowers and should likewise be at rest and have force, and most dreaded is moving and changing into harm or control. If Output is strong and Pressure weak, the pox flowers are sure to be sparse and clear, and will surely come to a good completion.

zh: 官强而痘难开朗，福旺则花必稀疏
yi: 官爻强，痘就难以开朗；福神旺，花一定稀疏
en: If Pressure is strong the pox will hardly open up clear; if Output is strong the flowers will surely be sparse

zh: 官鬼爻为痘症，宜静不宜动，动则有变。
静而衰者痘稀，旺而动者痘密。
父神为痘花之主，亦宜安静有气，最忌动化伤克；
若得福旺官衰，痘花定然稀朗，必好收功也。
yi: 官鬼爻是痘症，适合安静、不适合发动，动了就有变化。
安静而衰的痘稀，旺而发动的痘密。
父母爻是痘花的主，也适合安静有气，最忌讳发动后变出伤克；
如果福神旺、官爻衰，痘花一定稀疏明朗，一定能好好收功。
en: The Pressure line is the pox itself; it should be at rest and not move, and if it moves there is change.
If at rest and weak, the pox is sparse; if strong and moving, the pox is dense.
The Resource line is the master of the pox flowers and should also be at rest with force, and most dreaded is moving and changing into harm or control;
if Output is strong and Pressure weak, the pox flowers are sure to be sparse and clear, and will surely come to a good completion.

note.yi: 「父神」注里没有解释，按上下文是父母爻（它生官鬼，所以说是痘花之主）。增删卜易的野鹤也说鬼爻旺相、临日月又有生扶花必稠密，空破休囚墓绝痘疏朗（LY.ILL.ZS.20），和这里「静而衰者痘稀，旺而动者痘密」一致；这里多了福神旺则花稀的一层。
note.en: 'Fu shen' is not explained in the commentary and by context is the Resource line (it generates Pressure, hence the master of the pox flowers). The Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi also says that a strong Pressure line on the Day or Month with support brings dense flowers, and Void, broken, resting, trapped, entombed or extinct brings sparse pox (LY.ILL.ZS.20), which agrees with 'at rest and weak, sparse; strong and moving, dense' here; this adds the further point that strong Output makes the flowers sparse.

units.title: 墓库不宜临用：用神入墓库，痘初难起发，后来病人神志昏倦，难收功

rule.yi: 用神不适合落在墓库上：痘喜欢起发，发出来以后又喜欢人神志清楚；用神入了墓库，一开始难以起发，后来病人一定神志昏沉疲倦，主难以收功。
rule.en: The Subject should not sit in a tomb or storehouse: the pox likes to erupt, and once erupted likes the patient to be clear in spirit; if the Subject enters a tomb, at first it is hard for it to erupt, and later the patient is surely dull and drowsy in spirit, which means it is hard to bring to completion.

zh: 墓库不宜临用
yi: 用神不适合落在墓库上
en: The Subject should not sit in a tomb or storehouse

zh: 痘喜起发，既发又喜神清，若用神入墓库，初难起发，后必神思昏倦，主难收功也。
yi: 痘喜欢起发，发出来以后又喜欢人神志清楚；如果用神入了墓库，开始就难起发，后来一定神志昏沉疲倦，主难以收功。
en: The pox likes to erupt, and once erupted it likes the patient to be clear in spirit; if the Subject enters a tomb, at first it is hard for it to erupt, and later the patient will surely be dull and drowsy, which means it is hard to bring to completion.

units.title: 休囚岂可持身：出花的人要体旺才易收功，用神休囚必是体弱，再无原神日月生扶，后来也有变

rule.yi: 出花的人要身体强旺才容易收功；用神休囚，一定是身体虚弱，再没有原神、日、月来生扶的，后来也会有变化。
rule.en: A person having the pox should be of strong body, and then it is easy to bring to completion; if the Subject is resting or trapped, the body is surely weak, and if in addition no Support, Day or Month generates or supports it, there will be change later on.

zh: 休囚岂可持身
yi: 休囚的爻，怎么可以持身呢
en: How can a resting or trapped line hold up the body

zh: 出花之人宜于体旺，则易收功，如用神休囚，必是体弱，再无原神日月生扶者，后亦有变。
yi: 出花的人适合身体强旺，这样就容易收功；如果用神休囚，一定是身体虚弱，再没有原神、日、月来生扶的，后来也会有变化。
en: A person having the pox should be of strong body, and then it is easy to bring to completion; if the Subject is resting or trapped, the body is surely weak, and if in addition no Support, Day or Month generates or supports it, there will be change later on.

note.yi: 经文只有「休囚岂可持身」六个字，没有说是谁休囚；注把它解成用神休囚。
note.en: The verse is only the six characters 'how can resting or trapped hold the body' and does not say what is resting or trapped; the commentary takes it as the Subject.

units.title: 卦现官多防贼痘为害：官鬼不宜多，鬼多则痘分粗细，无子孙出现时痘密中恐夹有毒痘，名贼痘，不去则害一身痘

rule.yi: 卦里官爻出现得多，要防备贼痘为害：官鬼不适合多，鬼多的话痘就分粗和细；如果没有子孙出现，恐怕在密密的痘当中夹着有毒的痘，名叫贼痘，如果不把它除去，就会害了满身的痘。
rule.en: If many Pressure lines appear in the hexagram, guard against the harm of thief pox: there should not be many Pressure lines, and with many the pox divide into coarse and fine; if no Output appears, there may be poisonous pox among the dense ones, called thief pox, and if it is not removed it will spoil the pox over the whole body.

zh: 卦现官多，防贼痘之为害
yi: 卦里官爻出现得多，要防备贼痘为害
en: If many Pressure lines appear in the hexagram, guard against the harm of thief pox

zh: 官鬼不宜多，鬼多则痘分粗细，如无子孙出现，恐痘密之中间有毒痘，其名曰贼痘，如不去之，则害一身痘矣。
yi: 官鬼不适合多，鬼多的话痘就分粗细；如果没有子孙出现，恐怕在密密的痘当中夹着有毒的痘，名叫贼痘，如果不把它除去，就会害了满身的痘。
en: There should not be many Pressure lines; with many, the pox divide into coarse and fine; if no Output appears, there may be poisonous pox among the dense ones, called thief pox, and if it is not removed it will spoil the pox over the whole body.

note.yi: 注里没有说怎样「去」贼痘，只说不去会害一身痘。「贼痘」是这一章自己的名目，书里其他地方没有再讲。
note.en: The commentary does not say how to remove a thief pox, only that if it is not removed it spoils the pox over the whole body. 'Thief pox' is this chapter's own term and the book does not treat it elsewhere.

units.title: 爻临福众虑进补以招殃：子孙爻不宜多现，只要旺相有气；多现则不宜用补药、食补物，用补反有害

rule.yi: 卦里福神多，要担心进补反而招来祸殃：子孙爻不适合出现得多，只要旺相有气就行；如果出现得多，就不适合用补药、吃补的东西，用了补，反而恐怕有害。
rule.en: If many Output lines appear, beware that taking tonics may invite calamity: Output lines should not appear in numbers, and it is enough that one is strong and has force; if many appear, it is not suitable to use tonic medicines or eat tonic foods, and if tonics are used they may do harm instead.

zh: 爻临福众，虑进补以招殃
yi: 卦里福神多，要担心进补反而招来祸殃
en: If many Output lines appear, beware that taking tonics may invite calamity

zh: 子孙之爻不宜多现，只要旺相有气，如多现不宜用补药食补物，若用补反恐有害也。
yi: 子孙爻不适合出现得多，只要旺相有气就行；如果出现得多，就不适合用补药、吃补的东西，如果用补，反而恐怕有害。
en: Output lines should not appear in numbers; it is enough that one is strong and has force; if many appear, it is not suitable to use tonic medicines or eat tonic foods, and if tonics are used they may do harm instead.

units.title: 乱动皆非吉、伏吟亦是凶：各种卦都怕乱动，占卜都怕伏吟，痘花更不例外

rule.yi: 卦里乱动都不吉利，伏吟也是凶：各种卦都怕乱动，何况是痘花；凡是占卜都怕伏吟，难道只有痘症才怕吗。
rule.en: Lines moving in disorder are all inauspicious, and Hidden Chant is also ominous: every hexagram fears lines moving in disorder, let alone the pox flowers; all divining fears Hidden Chant, is it only so for pox?

zh: 乱动皆非吉，伏吟亦是凶
yi: 乱动都不吉，伏吟也是凶
en: Lines moving in disorder are all inauspicious, and Hidden Chant is also ominous

zh: 诸卦皆怕乱动，何况于痘花？
凡占皆畏伏吟，岂独痘症乎？
yi: 各种卦都怕乱动，何况是痘花？
凡是占卜都怕伏吟，难道只有痘症才怕吗？
en: Every hexagram fears lines moving in disorder, let alone the pox flowers.
In all divining Hidden Chant is feared; is it only so for pox?

note.yi: 这一条的注是两句反问，没有给新的判据，只是说明：乱动和伏吟是各种占都忌的，痘疹并不例外。
note.en: The commentary here is two rhetorical questions and gives no new criterion; it says only that disorderly movement and Hidden Chant are dreaded in every kind of divination and the pox is no exception.

units.title: 子孙发动当勿药而自痊、父母交重纵延医而难治：子孙发动而不遇日月动变伤克，用药立效，喻之不药也能好

rule.yi: 子孙发动，应当不用吃药自己就好；父母爻交重（发动），即使请医生也难以治好。具体说，子孙发动、没有遇到日、月、动爻、变爻的伤克，如果占用药，应当许他立刻见效，所以用「不吃药也能好」来比喻。
rule.en: If Output moves, one recovers of oneself without medicine; if Resource moves, then even calling a doctor it is hard to cure. Specifically, if Output moves and meets no harm or control from the Day, Month, moving or changed lines, then if one divines about taking medicine one may promise that it will take effect at once, so it is put as 'it can be cured without medicine'.

zh: 子孙发动，当勿药而自痊；
父母交重，纵延医而难治
yi: 子孙发动，应当不用吃药自己就好；
父母爻交重，即使请医生也难以治好
en: If Output moves, one recovers of oneself without medicine;
if Resource moves, then even calling a doctor it is hard to cure

zh: 如子孙发动，不遇日月动变伤克者，倘卜用药，当许立效，故喻之不药而能愈也。
yi: 如果子孙发动，没有遇到日、月、动爻、变爻的伤克，如果占用药，应当许他立刻见效，所以用「不吃药也能好」来比喻。
en: If Output moves and meets no harm or control from the Day, Month, moving or changed lines, then if one divines about taking medicine one may promise that it will take effect at once, so it is put as 'it can be cured without medicine'.

note.yi: 这一条对痘疹讲的「子孙发动」和增删卜易讲的「子孙持世发动服之立可解忧」（LY.ILL.ZS.37）、「子孙制鬼最喜旺相生扶」（LY.ILL.ZS.30）是同一个看法；「父母交重」难治，和增删卜易的「父爻持世妙药难调」（LY.ILL.ZS.32）也一致。「交重」就是发动。
note.en: What is said here of a moving Output line agrees with the Zengshan Buyi's 'Output on the Self position or moving, taking it gives immediate relief' (LY.ILL.ZS.37) and 'Output controlling Pressure most wants to be strong and supported' (LY.ILL.ZS.30); that a moving Resource line is hard to cure also agrees with the Zengshan Buyi's 'Resource holding Self: even wonderful medicine is hard to mix' (LY.ILL.ZS.32). 'Jiaozhong' simply means moving.

units.title: 财动卦中宜调脾胃：财爻主饮食，宜旺不宜空（空则不思饮食），宜静不宜动（动则生助官鬼）；恐多食伤脾胃，须调养

rule.yi: 财爻在卦中发动，适合调理脾胃：财爻代表饮食，适合旺、不适合空，空了就不想吃东西；适合安静、不适合发动，发动了就生助官鬼，恐怕因为吃得太多而伤了脾胃，所以要调养。
rule.en: If Wealth moves in the hexagram, it is right to regulate the spleen and stomach: Wealth stands for food and drink; it should be strong and not Void, for if Void the patient has no wish to eat; it should be at rest and not move, for if it moves it generates and helps Pressure, and for fear that eating too much will harm the spleen and stomach, it must be regulated and nourished.

zh: 财动卦中宜调脾胃
yi: 财爻在卦中发动，适合调理脾胃
en: If Wealth moves in the hexagram, it is right to regulate the spleen and stomach

zh: 财为饮食，宜旺不宜空，空则不思饮食；
宜静不宜动，动则生助官鬼。
恐因多食而伤脾胃，故须调养。
yi: 财爻代表饮食，适合旺、不适合空，空了就不想吃东西；
适合安静、不适合发动，发动了就生助官鬼。
恐怕因为吃得太多而伤了脾胃，所以要调养。
en: Wealth stands for food and drink; it should be strong and not Void, for if Void the patient has no wish to eat;
it should be at rest and not move, for if it moves it generates and helps Pressure.
For fear that eating too much will harm the spleen and stomach, it must be regulated and nourished.

units.title: 兄兴象内须理胸怀：兄弟爻发动克财爻，主饮食少进或乏调理；在间爻宜宽胸理气，临朱雀必因生气而不思饮食

rule.yi: 兄弟爻在卦里兴起，要调理胸怀：财是用来调理的东西，兄是防气的神；如果遇到兄弟爻发动，就伤克财爻，主吃得少，或者缺少调理；如果落在间爻，适合宽胸理气；如果带朱雀，一定是生了气而不想吃东西。
rule.en: If Peer rises in the hexagram, the chest and mind must be regulated: Wealth is the thing for regulation and Peer is the spirit that guards against breath and temper; if the Peer line moves, it harms and controls the Wealth line, which means little food is taken or regulation is lacking; if it is on a between line, ease the chest and regulate the qi; if it carries the Vermilion Bird, the patient is surely angry and does not want to eat.

zh: 兄兴象内须理胸怀
yi: 兄弟爻在卦里兴起，要调理胸怀
en: If Peer rises in the hexagram, the chest and mind must be regulated

zh: 财为调理之物，兄为气防之神，如遇兄弟爻发动，则伤克财爻，主饮食少进或乏于调理。
如在间爻，宜宽胸理气；
如临朱雀，必感怒而不思饮食。
yi: 财是用来调理的东西，兄是防气的神，如果遇到兄弟爻发动，就伤克财爻，主吃得少，或者缺少调理。
如果落在间爻，适合宽胸理气；
如果带朱雀，一定是生了气而不想吃东西。
en: Wealth is the thing for regulation and Peer is the spirit that guards against breath and temper; if the Peer line moves, it harms and controls the Wealth line, which means little food is taken or regulation is lacking.
If it is on a between line, ease the chest and regulate the qi;
if it carries the Vermilion Bird, the patient is surely angry and does not want to eat.

note.yi: 「兄为气防之神」注里没有再解释，按字面译作防气的神（兄弟克财，所以由它管吃与不吃的火气）。
note.en: 'Peer is the spirit that guards against breath' is not explained further in the commentary and is rendered literally (Peer controls Wealth, so it governs the temper that bears on eating and not eating).

units.title: 食口腹而增忧多为帮官伤世：财爻动生官鬼，又见官鬼动克世身主象，必因贪口腹增病，或未出痘前已停食

rule.yi: 贪吃口腹反而增加忧患，多半是帮了官爻、伤了世爻：财爻发动就生官鬼；如果卦中又见官鬼发动而克世爻、卦身、主象的，一定是因为贪吃而使病加重，或者没出痘之前就已经停食了。
rule.en: Indulging the mouth and belly adds to the trouble, mostly because it helps Pressure and harms the Self: when the Wealth line moves it generates Pressure; if in the hexagram Pressure also moves and controls the Self, the Body or the main image, it is surely because of indulging the mouth and belly that the illness has grown worse, or the patient had already stopped eating before the pox came out.

zh: 食口腹而增忧，多为帮官伤世
yi: 贪吃口腹反而增加忧患，多半是帮了官爻、伤了世爻
en: Indulging the mouth and belly adds to the trouble, mostly because it helps Pressure and harms the Self

zh: 财爻发动则生官鬼，若卦中又见官鬼发动而克世身主象者，必因贪口腹以致增病，或未出痘之前已停食也。
yi: 财爻发动就生官鬼；如果卦中又见官鬼发动而克世爻、卦身、主象的，一定是因为贪吃而使病加重，或者没出痘之前就已经停食了。
en: When the Wealth line moves it generates Pressure; if in the hexagram Pressure also moves and controls the Self, the Body or the main image, it is surely because of indulging the mouth and belly that the illness has grown worse, or the patient had already stopped eating before the pox came out.

note.yi: 注里的「世身主象」是三样东西：世爻、卦身、主象（主象就是用神所代表的那一象）。
note.en: The 'Self, Body and main image' of the commentary are three things: the Self line, the hexagram Body and the main image (the image that the Subject stands for).

units.title: 爱滋味而进食定因助福生身：兄弟克财则不思饮食，子孙也动而生世身用象，叫助福生世，出痘的人起初不思食，因爱一味引开胃口才能进食

rule.yi: 爱某种味道才肯吃东西，一定是因为帮了福神、生了世身：兄弟爻本来克财，一发动就不想吃东西；如果子孙也发动，动来生世爻、卦身、用神的象，叫做助福生世，主出痘的人起初不想吃，因为爱吃某一种味道，把胃口引开了，才吃得下东西。
rule.en: Eating because one loves a certain flavour is surely because it helps Output and generates the Self and the Body: Peer by nature controls Wealth, and when it moves the patient has no wish to eat; if Output also moves and moves to generate the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, this is called helping Output to generate the Self, and it means the person with the pox at first has no wish to eat, but because he loves one flavour his appetite is drawn open and only then can he take food.

zh: 爱滋味而进食，定因助福生身
yi: 爱某种味道才肯吃东西，一定是因为帮了福神、生了世身
en: Eating because one loves a certain flavour is surely because it helps Output and generates the Self and the Body

zh: 兄弟本是克财，动则不思饮食，若得子孙亦动，动来生世身用象者，谓之助福生世，主出痘之人初不思食，因爱一味引开胃口，始能进食也。
yi: 兄弟本来克财，发动了就不想吃东西；如果子孙也发动，动来生世爻、卦身、用神的象，叫做助福生世，主出痘的人起初不想吃，因为爱吃某一种味道，把胃口引开了，才吃得下东西。
en: Peer by nature controls Wealth, and when it moves the patient has no wish to eat; if Output also moves, and moves to generate the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, this is called helping Output to generate the Self, and it means the person with the pox at first has no wish to eat, but because he loves one flavour his appetite is drawn open and only then can he take food.

units.title: 卦遇六冲难起发、爻逢六合好收功：占近病喜六冲（冲散灾殃），占痘症不然，花逢冲则败，如风雨侵花；六合卦或用神逢生合则易起发、好收功

rule.yi: 卦遇到六冲，痘难起发；爻逢到六合，痘好收功。占近病，喜欢遇到六冲，叫做冲散灾殃；只有占痘症不是这样，叫做花遇到冲就败，好比风雨侵袭花朵，开始难起发，后来也不能收功。如果遇到六合卦，或者用神逢到生、合，就容易起发，一定能好好收功。
rule.en: A hexagram meeting Six-Clash makes the pox hard to erupt; lines meeting Six-Combine bring a good completion. In divining a recent illness one is glad to meet Six-Clash, which is called clashing the calamity apart; only in divining pox is it not so, for it is said that a flower meeting a clash is ruined, like wind and rain attacking flowers: at first it hardly erupts, and later it does not come to completion. If it meets a Six-Combine hexagram, or the Subject meets generation or combination, it erupts easily and will surely come to a good completion.

zh: 卦遇六冲难起发，爻逢六合好收功
yi: 卦遇到六冲难起发，爻逢到六合好收功
en: A hexagram meeting Six-Clash hardly erupts; lines meeting Six-Combine come to a good completion

zh: 凡卜近病喜遇六冲，谓之冲散灾殃，唯卜痘症则不然，谓之花逢冲则败，犹如妨雨侵花，初难起发，后不收功。
如遇六合卦，或用神逢生合，则易起发定然，必好收功也。
yi: 凡是占近病喜欢遇到六冲，叫做冲散灾殃，只有占痘症不是这样，叫做花遇到冲就败，好比风雨侵袭花朵，开始难起发，后来不能收功。
如果遇到六合卦，或者用神逢到生、合，就容易起发，一定能好好收功。
en: In divining a recent illness one is glad to meet Six-Clash, which is called clashing the calamity apart; only in divining pox is it not so, for it is said that a flower meeting a clash is ruined, like wind and rain attacking flowers: at first it hardly erupts, and later it does not come to completion.
If it meets a Six-Combine hexagram, or the Subject meets generation or combination, it erupts easily and will surely come to a good completion.

note.yi: 注里「犹如妨雨侵花」的「妨雨」，按上下文应是「风雨」的误字，译作风雨；书里没有说明。增删卜易也说见花问吉凶忌六冲（LY.ILL.ZS.19），和这里一致；至于占近病遇六冲的好处，见增删卜易 LY.ILL.ZS.02。
note.en: In the commentary's 'like fang rain attacking flowers', 'fang rain' is by context a mis-written 'wind and rain' and is rendered so; the book does not say. The Zengshan Buyi also says that in asking the fortune of a pox already out a Six-Clash is to be avoided (LY.ILL.ZS.19), which agrees; for the benefit of a Six-Clash in a recent illness see LY.ILL.ZS.02 in the Zengshan Buyi.

units.title: 闷而不发皆缘用伏加伤、发而不浆只为官空增制：用神出现不受伤克大吉；用神伏藏又受伤克难过四五朝；官爻旬空月破又遇日辰动爻克害，七八朝内恐不上浆

rule.yi: 痘闷着发不出来，都是因为用神伏藏又受了伤；发出来却不灌浆，只是因为官爻落空又加受制。用神出现、没有遇到日月动爻的刑冲克害，是大吉的兆头；用神伏藏、又受日月动爻的刑冲克害，要提防这个痘，很难过四五天，这是屡次应验的；官爻旬空、月破，又遇日辰动爻的克害，痘虽然起发了，七八天之内恐怕不能灌浆，难以收功。
rule.en: The pox stifled and unable to erupt is all because the Subject is hidden and further harmed; erupted but not filling with fluid is only because Pressure is Void and further controlled. If the Subject appears and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, it is a very auspicious sign; if the Subject is hidden and is struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, one must guard against this pox, and it is hard to get past four or five days, as has been proved again and again; if the Pressure line is Void or in Month-break and further meets control or harm from the Day or a moving line, then although the pox may erupt, within seven or eight days it may not fill with fluid, and it is hard to bring to completion.

zh: 闷而不发，皆缘用伏加伤；
发而不浆，只为官空增制
yi: 闷着发不出来，都是因为用神伏藏又受了伤；
发出来却不灌浆，只是因为官爻落空又加受制
en: Stifled and unable to erupt, all is because the Subject is hidden and further harmed;
erupted but not filling with fluid, only because Pressure is Void and further controlled

zh: 用神出现，不遇日月动爻刑冲克害，是大吉之兆；
如用神伏藏，再受日月动爻刑冲克害者，必是防痘，难过四五朝者屡验。
如官爻旬空月破，又遇日辰动爻克害者，痘虽起发，在七八朝之内恐不上浆，难于收功也。
须仔细而推详。
yi: 用神出现，没有遇到日、月、动爻的刑、冲、克、害，是大吉的兆头；
如果用神伏藏，又受到日、月、动爻的刑、冲、克、害，一定要提防这个痘，很难过四五天，这是屡次应验的。
如果官爻旬空、月破，又遇到日辰、动爻的克害，痘虽然起发了，七八天之内恐怕不能灌浆，难以收功。
要仔细推敲。
en: If the Subject appears and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, it is a very auspicious sign;

if the Subject is hidden and is further struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, one must surely guard against this pox, and it is hard to get past four or five days, as has been proved again and again.

If the Pressure line is Void or in Month-break, and further meets control or harm from the Day or a moving line, then although the pox may erupt, within seven or eight days it may not fill with fluid, and it is hard to bring to completion.
It must be worked out carefully.

note.yi: 「朝」是天，「四五朝」是四五天。「浆」「灌浆」是痘里长满浆水，是痘的一个阶段。注说「必是防痘」，意思含糊，按字面译作要提防这个痘。
note.en: 'Zhao' is a day, so 'four or five zhao' is four or five days. 'Fluid' (jiang) and 'filling with fluid' are the pox becoming full of fluid, a stage of the pox. The commentary's 'surely fang dou' is ambiguous and is rendered literally as guarding against this pox.

units.title: 原神若坏纵用现不祥、主象受伤得救护无碍：原神旬空或伏藏受伤、真空真破、化回头克，用神无根不吉；主象受伤而原神临月建日辰动爻救护，痘虽险可断不妨

rule.yi: 原神如果坏了，即使用神出现也不吉祥；主象受了伤，得到救护就没有妨碍。原神就是生用神的爻：原神旬空，或者伏藏又受伤克，主症状虚、身体弱，不补就不能起发，起发了也没有力气灌浆；原神遇到真空、真破，或者伏藏又受伤太过，或者变出回头克伤它，叫做原神受伤，用神没有根，怎么能得到生，不是吉祥的兆头。如果主象遇到伤克，而原神带着月建、日辰、动爻来救护，痘症虽然凶险，可以断定没有妨碍。
rule.en: If the Support is spoiled, then even if the Subject appears it is inauspicious; if the main image is wounded but gains rescue and protection, there is no obstruction. The Support is the line that generates the Subject: if it is Void, or hidden and struck by harm or control, the condition is one of emptiness and the body weak, so that without tonics it cannot erupt and once erupted has no strength to fill with fluid; if the Support meets true Void or true breaking, or is hidden and too badly wounded, or changes into a returning control that wounds it, this is called the Support wounded, the Subject has no root, and how can it be born? It is not an auspicious sign. If the main image meets harm or control but the Support, backed by the Month, the Day or a moving line, comes to rescue and protect it, then although the pox is dangerous, it may be judged that there is no obstruction.

zh: 原神若坏，纵用现兮不祥；
主象受伤，得救护兮无碍
yi: 原神如果坏了，即使用神出现也不吉祥；
主象受了伤，得到救护就没有妨碍
en: If the Support is spoiled, then even if the Subject appears it is inauspicious;
if the main image is wounded but gains rescue and protection, there is no obstruction

zh: 原神者，生用神之爻也，如原神旬空，若伏藏而夫伤克者，主症虚体弱，非补不能起发，既起发主发无力灌浆。
若原神值真空真破，或伏而受伤太过，或化回头克伤，谓之原神受伤，用神无根，焉能得生？
非吉祥之兆也。
如主象逢伤克，而遇原神临月建日辰动爻救护者，痘症虽险，可断不妨。
学者宜变通。
yi: 原神就是生用神的爻，如果原神旬空，或者伏藏又受伤克，主症状虚弱、体质弱，不补就不能起发，起发了也没有力气灌浆。
如果原神遇到真空、真破，或者伏藏又受伤太过，或者变出回头克伤它，叫做原神受伤，用神没有根，怎么能得到生？
这不是吉祥的兆头。
如果主象遇到伤克，而原神带着月建、日辰、动爻来救护，痘症虽然凶险，可以断定没有妨碍。
学的人要懂得变通。
en: The Support is the line that generates the Subject; if the Support is Void, or hidden and struck by harm or control, the condition is one of emptiness and the body weak: without tonics it cannot erupt, and once erupted it has no strength to fill with fluid.

If the Support meets true Void or true breaking, or is hidden and too badly wounded, or changes into a returning control that wounds it, this is called the Support wounded, the Subject has no root, and how can it be born?
This is not an auspicious sign.

If the main image meets harm or control but the Support, backed by the Month, the Day or a moving line, comes to rescue and protect it, then although the pox is dangerous, it may be judged that there is no obstruction.
The student should be flexible.

note.yi: 注的第一句「若伏藏而夫伤克者」里的「夫」按上下文应是「受」或「又」之类的误字，译作「又受伤克」；书里没有说明。「真空、真破」是真正的旬空、月破（不是被冲开、被填实的假空假破），书里没有在这里另作解释。「主象」就是用神所代表的那一象。
note.en: In the commentary's first sentence, 'hidden and fu struck', the character 'fu' is by context a mis-written 'shou' or 'you' and is rendered 'hidden and further struck'; the book does not say. 'True Void, true breaking' are a real Void and Month-break (as against a false one that has been clashed open or filled), which the book does not explain here. The 'main image' is the image the Subject stands for.

units.title: 福鬼若值青龙方宜种痘：子孙爻或官鬼爻临青龙、不遇日月动爻刑冲克害，占种痘大吉；官爻旬空或伏藏、福神不值青龙，种了也出不来

rule.yi: 福神或鬼爻如果带青龙，才适合种痘：子孙爻带青龙，或者官鬼爻带青龙，没有遇到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，占种痘是大吉的兆头；如果官爻旬空或者伏藏，福神又不带青龙，即使种了痘也出不来。
rule.en: Output or Pressure carrying the Azure Dragon means it is fit to inoculate: if the Output line carries the Azure Dragon, or the Pressure line carries the Azure Dragon, and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, then in divining about inoculation it is a very auspicious sign; if the Pressure line is Void or hidden and Output does not carry the Azure Dragon, then even if the pox is sown it will not come out.

zh: 福鬼若值青龙，方宜种痘
yi: 福神或鬼爻如果带青龙，才适合种痘
en: Output or Pressure carrying the Azure Dragon is what makes it fit to inoculate

zh: 或子孙爻临青龙，或官鬼爻临青龙，不遇日月动爻刑冲克害者，如卜种痘为大吉之兆；
如官爻旬空或伏藏，福神不值青龙，虽种豆亦不出也。
yi: 或者子孙爻带青龙，或者官鬼爻带青龙，没有遇到日、月、动爻的刑、冲、克、害，如果占种痘，是大吉的兆头；
如果官爻旬空或者伏藏，福神又不带青龙，即使种了痘也出不来。
en: Either the Output line carries the Azure Dragon or the Pressure line carries the Azure Dragon, and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines; if one divines about inoculation, it is a very auspicious sign;
if the Pressure line is Void or hidden and Output does not carry the Azure Dragon, then even if the pox is sown it will not come out.

note.yi: 「种痘」是把痘浆或痘痂接种到健康人身上，让他出一次轻的痘，以后不再得重的；「栽花」是它的雅称。注里「种豆」是「种痘」的误字。这是书里唯一讲种痘的一处。
note.en: 'Sowing the pox' (zhong dou) is inoculating a healthy person with pox matter so that he has a light case and does not get a severe one later; 'planting flowers' is its elegant name. The commentary's 'zhong dou' written with the bean character is a mis-write of the same. This is the only place in the book that treats inoculation.

units.title: 用煞如临白虎且慢栽花：用神或忌神带白虎，用神又受日月动爻刑冲克害，不宜种痘，恐反被害

rule.yi: 用神或者煞神如果带白虎，先别种痘。具体说，或者用神带白虎，或者忌神带白虎，用神又受到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不适合种痘，恐怕反而被害。
rule.en: If the Subject or the killing spirit carries the White Tiger, hold off sowing the pox for now. Specifically, either the Subject carries the White Tiger or the Adversary carries the White Tiger, and the Subject is struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines: it is not suitable to inoculate, for fear of being harmed instead.

zh: 用煞如临白虎，且慢栽花
yi: 用神或者煞神如果带白虎，先别种痘
en: If the Subject or the killing spirit carries the White Tiger, hold off sowing the pox for now

zh: 或用神临白虎，或忌神临白虎，用神受日月动爻刑冲克害者，不宜种痘，恐反被害耳。
yi: 或者用神带白虎，或者忌神带白虎，用神又受到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不适合种痘，恐怕反而被害。
en: Either the Subject carries the White Tiger or the Adversary carries the White Tiger, and the Subject is struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines: it is not suitable to inoculate, for fear of being harmed instead.

units.title: 玄武冲世冲身污妇冲魇而作变：玄武临财爻发动冲世身用象，是污妇冲魇致痘花变；玄武临应爻发动冲世身主象，是外人闯魇作变

rule.yi: 玄武冲世爻、冲卦身，是不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅，使痘起了变化。具体说，玄武带着财爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、用神的象，是因为不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅，使痘花起了变化；玄武带着应爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、主象，是被外人闯进来冲撞魇魅而起了变化。
rule.en: The Dark Tortoise clashing the Self and the Body means an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and made the pox change. Specifically, if the Dark Tortoise carries the Wealth line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, it is because an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and caused the pox flowers to change; if the Dark Tortoise carries the Other line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the main image, an outsider has burst in and clashed and cursed and caused the change.

zh: 玄武冲世冲身，污妇冲魇而作变
yi: 玄武冲世爻、冲卦身，是不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅而使痘起了变化
en: The Dark Tortoise clashing the Self and the Body means an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and made the pox change

zh: 玄武临财爻动来冲世身用象者，主因污妇冲魇致痘花作变。
如玄武临应爻动来冲世身主象，被外人闯魇作变也。
yi: 玄武带着财爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、用神的象，主因为不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅，使痘花起了变化。
如果玄武带着应爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、主象，是被外人闯进来冲撞魇魅而起了变化。
en: If the Dark Tortoise carries the Wealth line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, it is because an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and caused the pox flowers to change.
If the Dark Tortoise carries the Other line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the main image, an outsider has burst in and clashed and cursed and caused the change.

note.yi: 「污妇」是不洁的妇人，书里没有说指的是什么情形；「冲魇」是冲撞、魇魅，按字面译。这一条是把痘花的变化归给外来的人事，不是归给病人自己的身体。
note.en: An 'unclean woman' is not defined in the book; 'chong yan' is to clash and to curse, rendered literally. This entry attributes a change in the pox flowers to a person coming from outside, not to the patient's own body.

units.title: 白虎临官临用火毒甚而未清：白虎是血神，临官鬼或用神又遇日月动爻刑冲克害，不是生痰就是结毒；毒结的部位按宫论（乾头面、坤腹、震足、巽股、艮手、离目、坎耳、兑口）

rule.yi: 白虎带官爻或带用神，火毒很重而没有清干净。白虎是血神，如果带官鬼或带用神，又遇到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不是生痰，一定是毒结在体内；毒结的部位按宫来推：乾宫在头脸，坤宫在腹，震宫在脚，巽宫在大腿，艮宫在手，离宫在眼，坎宫在耳，兑宫在口。
rule.en: The White Tiger on Pressure or on the Subject means the fire poison is heavy and not yet cleared. The White Tiger is the blood spirit; if it sits on Pressure or on the Subject and meets punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, then if it is not phlegm being produced, it is surely poison lodged within; the place where the poison lodges is worked out by the palace: the Qian palace, the head and face; Kun, the belly; Zhen, the foot; Xun, the thigh; Gen, the hand; Li, the eye; Kan, the ear; Dui, the mouth.

zh: 白虎临官临用，火毒甚而未清
yi: 白虎带官爻或带用神，火毒很重而没有清干净
en: The White Tiger on Pressure or on the Subject: the fire poison is heavy and not yet cleared

zh: 白虎是血神，如临官鬼或临用神，而遇日月动爻刑冲克害，若非生痰，定是结毒。
如在乾宫毒结头面，坤腹、震足、巽股、艮手、离目、坎耳、兑口等类推之。
yi: 白虎是血神，如果带官鬼或带用神，又遇到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不是生痰，一定是毒结在体内。
如果在乾宫，毒结在头脸；坤宫是腹，震宫是脚，巽宫是大腿，艮宫是手，离宫是眼睛，坎宫是耳朵，兑宫是口，照这样类推。
en: The White Tiger is the blood spirit; if it sits on Pressure or on the Subject and meets punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, then if it is not phlegm being produced, it is surely poison lodged within.
In the Qian palace the poison lodges in the head and face; Kun is the belly, Zhen the foot, Xun the thigh, Gen the hand, Li the eye, Kan the ear, Dui the mouth, and so on by analogy.

note.yi: 这里兑宫是「口」，而下面 LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 里兑象是「面」，同一章里兑宫的部位有两说，见那一条。增删卜易也有按宫论花长在哪里的说法（LY.ILL.ZS.20：乾多生头、坤多腹、艮多手、兑多口、坎离上身、震巽下身），那里讲的是痘长在哪里，这里讲的是毒结在哪里。
note.en: Here the Dui palace is the 'mouth', while in LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 below the Dui image is the 'face'; the palace's place has two readings in the same chapter, see that entry. The Zengshan Buyi also places the flowers by palace (LY.ILL.ZS.20: Qian mostly on the head, Kun on the belly, Gen on the hands, Dui on the mouth, Kan and Li on the upper body, Zhen and Xun on the lower), but there it says where the pox will grow, and here where the poison lodges.

units.title: 身上虎须向五行言带疾：卦身临福德吉神主无痘毒，临官鬼必有结毒成疾之处——金鬼肺经鼻孔生疮或耳疾、木鬼肝经两目或耳疾、水鬼肾经耳枯唇疾、火鬼心经舌焦目疾、土鬼脾经口如鱼口鼻梁疾；休囚见福神发动可用药愈，无福神克制加白虎是终身之疾

rule.yi: 卦身这一爻主出痘的人从头到尾的事：落在福德这个吉神上，没有痘毒；落在官鬼上，一定有毒结成病的地方，按官鬼的五行说会留下什么毛病：金鬼是肺经炎毒未消，鼻孔里生疮或右耳有毛病；木鬼是肝经火毒未消，两眼里出痘或右耳有毛病；水鬼是肾经火毒未消，两耳干枯，嘴唇有毛病；火鬼是心经火毒未消，舌头干焦，眼睛有毛病；土鬼是脾经火毒未清，嘴像鱼嘴，鼻梁有毛病。己土官鬼带着卦身的，如果休囚、又见福神发动，用药就能好；如果没有福神克制，反而加上白虎附着，就有损失，是终身的毛病。
rule.en: The Body line governs the whole course of the person with the pox from start to finish: if it sits on Output, the fortunate spirit, there is no pox poison; if it sits on Pressure, there is surely a place where poison lodges and becomes a lingering ailment, and by the element of Pressure it is worked out as follows: a Metal ghost, inflammatory poison of the lung channel not dispersed, with sores in the nostrils or an ailment of the right ear; Wood, fire poison of the liver channel not dispersed, pox within both eyes or an ailment of the right ear; Water, fire poison of the kidney channel not dispersed, both ears dry and withered and an ailment of the lips; Fire, fire poison of the heart channel not dispersed, a dry scorched tongue and an eye ailment; Earth, fire poison of the spleen channel not cleared, a mouth like a fish's mouth and an ailment at the bridge of the nose. If a Ji-Earth Pressure line sits on the Body and is resting or trapped, and Output is seen moving, medicine can cure it; if no Output controls it and the White Tiger clings to it instead, there is loss, and it is a lifelong ailment.

zh: 身上虎须向五行言带疾
yi: 身上有虎，要从五行来说会留下什么毛病
en: With the Tiger on the Body, speak by the five elements of what ailment will linger

zh: 大凡卦身一爻，主痘人始终之事，若临福德吉神，主无痘毒；
如临官鬼，必有结毒成疾之处。
如遇金鬼，系肺经炎毒未消，鼻孔内生疮或右耳带疾；
如临木鬼，系肝经火毒未消，主两目内出痘或右耳带疾。
如遇水鬼，系肾经火毒未消，主两耳干枯，嘴唇带疾；
如官鬼属火，系心经火毒未消，舌上干焦，主带目疾；
如官鬼属土，系脾经火毒未清，主口如鱼口，鼻梁带疾。
己土官鬼凡属临持卦身，如值休囚，见福神发动者用药可愈；
如无福神克制反加白虎附持，则有损失，乃终身之疾也。
yi: 大凡卦身这一爻，主出痘的人始终的事；如果落在福德这个吉神上，主没有痘毒；
如果落在官鬼上，一定有毒结成病的地方。
如果遇到金鬼，是肺经的炎毒没有消，鼻孔里生疮，或者右耳留下毛病；
如果落在木鬼上，是肝经的火毒没有消，主两眼里出痘，或者右耳留下毛病。
如果遇到水鬼，是肾经的火毒没有消，主两耳干枯，嘴唇留下毛病；
如果官鬼属火，是心经的火毒没有消，舌头干焦，主留下眼病；
如果官鬼属土，是脾经的火毒没有清，主嘴像鱼嘴，鼻梁留下毛病。
己土官鬼凡是带着卦身的，如果遇到休囚，又见福神发动的，用药就能好；
如果没有福神来克制，反而加上白虎附着，就有损失，是终身的毛病。
en: Generally the Body line governs the whole course of the person with the pox from start to finish; if it sits on Output, the fortunate spirit, there will be no pox poison;
if it sits on Pressure, there will surely be a place where poison lodges and becomes a lingering ailment.
If it meets a Metal ghost, the inflammatory poison of the lung channel has not dispersed, with sores inside the nostrils or a lingering ailment in the right ear;
if it sits on a Wood ghost, the fire poison of the liver channel has not dispersed, and pox comes out within both eyes or an ailment lingers in the right ear.
If it meets a Water ghost, the fire poison of the kidney channel has not dispersed, and both ears are dry and withered and an ailment lingers in the lips;
if the Pressure line is Fire, the fire poison of the heart channel has not dispersed, the tongue is dry and scorched, and an eye ailment lingers;
if the Pressure line is Earth, the fire poison of the spleen channel has not cleared, the mouth becomes like a fish's mouth and an ailment lingers at the bridge of the nose.
Whenever a Ji-Earth Pressure line sits on the Body, if it is resting or trapped and Output is seen moving, medicine can cure it;
if there is no Output to control it and the White Tiger is added instead and clings to it, there is loss, and it is a lifelong ailment.

note.yi: 经文「身上虎须向五行言带疾」的「虎」是白虎；「带疾」是痘好了以后留下的毛病。注里金鬼和木鬼两处都写「右耳带疾」，书里没有解释。「己土」是阴土（丑未），注里单提它，没有说为什么。这一条讲的是病好以后留下什么，不是病重不重，后面 LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 讲同一个题目按八宫来推。
note.en: The 'tiger' in the verse's 'with the Tiger on the Body' is the White Tiger; 'lingering ailment' is what is left after the pox has healed. The commentary writes 'an ailment of the right ear' for both the Metal and the Wood ghost, which the book does not explain. 'Ji Earth' is yin Earth (Chou and Wei) and the commentary singles it out without saying why. This entry is about what remains after recovery, not how severe the illness is; LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 below treats the same subject by the eight palaces.

units.title: 爻中煞当凭八卦论终身：白虎鬼居乾宫带疾在头、兑在面、震在足、巽在股、坎在耳、离在目、艮在手、坤在腹；福神克制则易医，加白虎持临是终身之疾

rule.yi: 爻里的煞，要凭八卦来论一生留下什么毛病：白虎、鬼在乾宫，毛病在头；在兑卦，在脸；在震卦，在脚；在巽卦，在大腿；在坎卦，在耳朵；在离卦，在眼睛；在艮卦，在手；在坤卦，在肚子。以上八个宫里所遇到的鬼爻，如果遇到福神克制，就容易医好；如果再加上白虎带着，就是终身的毛病。
rule.en: The killing spirit within the lines should be judged by the eight trigrams for the lifelong ailment: if the Tiger ghost sits in the Qian palace, the ailment lingers in the head; in the Dui image, in the face; in Zhen, in the foot; in Xun, in the thigh; in Kan, in the ear; in Li, in the eye; in Gen, in the hand; in Kun, in the belly. For the Pressure line in any of the eight palaces above, if Output meets and controls it, treatment easily cures it; if the White Tiger is added and sits on it, it is a lifelong ailment.

zh: 爻中煞当凭八卦论终身
yi: 爻里的煞，要凭八卦来论一生留下什么毛病
en: The killing spirit within the lines should be judged by the eight trigrams for the lifelong ailment

zh: 如虎鬼居乾宫，则带疾在头；
如居兑象，则带疾在面；
如居震卦，带疾在足；
如居巽卦，带疾在股；
如居坎卦，带疾在耳；
如居离卦，带疾在目；
如居艮卦，带疾在手；
如居坤卦，带疾在腹。
以上八宫所值鬼爻，如遇福神克制，则医治易愈，如再加白虎持临，乃终身之疾也。
学者依理而推。
yi: 如果白虎、鬼在乾宫，留下的毛病在头；
如果在兑卦，在脸；
如果在震卦，在脚；
如果在巽卦，在大腿；
如果在坎卦，在耳朵；
如果在离卦，在眼睛；
如果在艮卦，在手；
如果在坤卦，在肚子。
以上八个宫里所遇到的鬼爻，如果遇到福神克制，就容易医好；如果再加上白虎带着，就是终身的毛病。
学的人要按道理去推。
en: If the Tiger ghost sits in the Qian palace, the ailment lingers in the head;
if in the Dui image, in the face;
if in the Zhen trigram, in the foot;
if in the Xun trigram, in the thigh;
if in the Kan trigram, in the ear;
if in the Li trigram, in the eye;
if in the Gen trigram, in the hand;
if in the Kun trigram, in the belly.
For the Pressure line in any of the eight palaces above, if Output meets and controls it, treatment easily cures it; if the White Tiger is added and sits on it, it is a lifelong ailment.
The student should work it out by reason.

dispute.yi: 兑宫的部位，同一章里有两说：LY.ILL.BSZZ.23 说兑宫毒结在口，这一条说兑象带疾在面。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The place of the Dui palace has two readings in this one chapter: LY.ILL.BSZZ.23 says the poison lodges in the mouth in the Dui palace, and this entry says the ailment lingers in the face in the Dui image. The book does not decide.

note.yi: 这里的分布是乾头、兑面、震足、巽股、坎耳、离目、艮手、坤腹。增删卜易讲花长在哪里，说乾多生头、坤多腹、艮多手、兑多口、坎离上身、震巽下身（LY.ILL.ZS.20），大体和这里相近，只是那里讲的是痘长在哪里，这里讲的是好了以后留下什么。
note.en: The distribution here is Qian the head, Dui the face, Zhen the foot, Xun the thigh, Kan the ear, Li the eye, Gen the hand, Kun the belly. The Zengshan Buyi, on where the flowers grow, says Qian mostly the head, Kun the belly, Gen the hands, Dui the mouth, Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower body (LY.ILL.ZS.20), which is broadly close, except that there it says where the pox grows and here what is left after recovery.

units.title: 金为肺腑增疼增嗽非宜、火属心经发疮发斑大忌：官鬼属金毒发肺部主身痛咳嗽须防鼻偏；官鬼属火毒发心经，起初防发斑、继防发疮及舌头宿硬；衰静者轻、旺动者重

rule.yi: 金对应肺腑，加重疼痛、加重咳嗽都不相宜；火属心经，发疮、发斑是大忌。具体说，官鬼属金，毒发在肺部，主身体作痛或咳嗽，要防鼻子歪偏；官鬼属火，毒发在心经，是火毒的症候，起初要防发斑，接着要防发疮和舌头长久僵硬。衰而静的轻，旺而动的更重。
rule.en: Metal is the lungs and viscera, and increased pain or increased cough is unfavourable; Fire belongs to the heart channel, and breaking out in sores or spots is a great taboo. Specifically, if the Pressure line is Metal, the poison breaks out in the lungs, bringing bodily pain or cough, and one must guard against a crooked nose; if the Pressure line is Fire, the poison breaks out in the heart channel and is a fire-poison condition; at first guard against spots, then against sores and a stiffened tongue that stays so. If weak and still it is light; if strong and moving it is heavier still.

zh: 金为肺腑，增疼增嗽非宜；
火属心经，发疮发斑大忌
yi: 金对应肺腑，加重疼痛、加重咳嗽都不相宜；
火属心经，发疮、发斑是大忌
en: Metal is the lungs and viscera, and increased pain or increased cough is unfavourable;
Fire belongs to the heart channel, and breaking out in sores or spots is a great taboo

zh: 官鬼属金，毒发肺部，主身体作痛或咳嗽，须防鼻偏；
如官鬼属火，毒发心经，乃火毒之症，起初防发斑，继之防发疮及舌头宿硬。
衰静者轻，旺动者尤重。
yi: 官鬼属金，毒发在肺部，主身体作痛或咳嗽，要防鼻子歪偏；
如果官鬼属火，毒发在心经，是火毒的症候，起初要防发斑，接着要防发疮和舌头长久僵硬。
衰而静的轻，旺而动的更重。
en: If the Pressure line is Metal, the poison breaks out in the lungs, bringing bodily pain or cough, and one must guard against a crooked nose;
if the Pressure line is Fire, the poison breaks out in the heart channel and is a fire-poison condition; at first guard against spots, then against sores and a stiffened tongue that stays so.
If weak and still it is light; if strong and moving it is heavier still.

units.title: 木鬼乃风邪未表、水宫而寒食尚停：官爻属木是风寒未表、肝经受毒，防呛喘发痒两目直视；官爻属水毒发肾经，防腰疼两耳焦干，尚有寒食停积发热宿浆

rule.yi: 木鬼是风邪还没有发散到表面，水宫则是寒凉的食物还停积着。官爻属木，一定是风寒没有发散出去，肝经受了毒，要防呛咳、气喘、发痒和两眼直瞪；官爻属水，毒发在肾经，要防腰疼和两耳焦干，还有寒凉的食物停积在里面，发热、浆水留着不化。
rule.en: A Wood ghost is a wind evil not yet expelled to the surface; in the Water palace cold food is still stagnant. If the Pressure line is Wood, it is surely because wind-cold has not been expelled and the liver channel has taken the poison, and one must guard against choking cough, wheezing, itching and a fixed stare of the eyes; if the Pressure line is Water, the poison breaks out in the kidney channel, and one must guard against lower-back pain and both ears becoming scorched and dry, and there is also cold food stagnant within, with fever and lingering fluid.

zh: 木鬼乃风邪未表，水宫而寒食尚停
yi: 木鬼是风邪还没有发散到表面，水宫则是寒凉的食物还停积着
en: A Wood ghost is a wind evil not yet expelled to the surface; in the Water palace cold food is still stagnant

zh: 木能生风，故主风邪，如官爻属木，必因未表风寒，肝经受毒，防呛喘发痒及两目直视；
如官爻属水，毒发肾经，防腰疼及两耳焦干，尚有寒食停积，发热宿浆。
yi: 木能生风，所以主风邪；如果官爻属木，一定是风寒没有发散出去，肝经受了毒，要防呛咳、气喘、发痒，以及两眼直瞪；
如果官爻属水，毒发在肾经，要防腰疼和两耳焦干，还有寒凉的食物停积在里面，发热、浆水留着不化。
en: Wood can produce wind, so it means wind evil; if the Pressure line is Wood, it is surely because wind-cold has not been expelled and the liver channel has taken the poison, and one must guard against choking cough, wheezing, itching and a fixed stare of the eyes;

if the Pressure line is Water, the poison breaks out in the kidney channel, and one must guard against lower-back pain and both ears becoming scorched and dry, and there is also cold food stagnant within, with fever and lingering fluid.

units.title: 麻面官乘四土、破碎遇三冲：官鬼临辰戌丑未四土，土属脾经，痘粗扁多密故云麻面，防口如鱼口；官爻遇年月日冲，灌浆后防破碎泄气

rule.yi: 麻面是官爻乘着辰、戌、丑、未这四个土，破碎是遇到三处冲。官鬼就是痘花，如果落在辰、戌、丑、未四个土上，土属脾经，主痘又粗又扁又多又密，所以叫麻面，要防嘴像鱼嘴；如果官爻遇到年、月、日（注里写「二建」）来冲，灌浆以后要防破碎、泄气。
rule.en: A pockmarked face is Pressure riding the four Earths, and breaking and shattering is meeting three clashes. The Pressure line is the pox flowers; if it sits on the four Earths, Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, Earth belongs to the spleen channel, and the pox are coarse, flat, many and dense, so it is called a pockmarked face, and one must guard against a mouth like a fish's mouth; if the Pressure line meets a clash from the Year, Month or Day (the commentary writes 'two rulers'), then after the fluid has filled one must guard against breaking apart and the leaking of qi.

zh: 麻面官乘四土，破碎遇三冲
yi: 麻面是官爻乘着辰、戌、丑、未四个土，破碎是遇到三处冲
en: A pockmarked face is Pressure riding the four Earths, and breaking and shattering is meeting three clashes

zh: 官鬼为痘花，如临辰戌丑未四土，土属脾经，主痘粗扁多密，故云麻面，防口如鱼口；
如官爻遇年月日二建冲者，灌浆后防破碎泄气。
yi: 官鬼就是痘花，如果落在辰、戌、丑、未四个土上，土属脾经，主痘又粗又扁又多又密，所以叫麻面，要防嘴像鱼嘴；
如果官爻遇到年、月、日（注里写「二建」）来冲，灌浆以后要防破碎、泄气。
en: The Pressure line is the pox flowers; if it sits on the four Earths, Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, Earth belongs to the spleen channel, and the pox are coarse, flat, many and dense, so it is called a pockmarked face, and one must guard against a mouth like a fish's mouth;
if the Pressure line meets a clash from the Year, Month or Day (the commentary writes 'two rulers'), then after the fluid has filled one must guard against breaking apart and the leaking of qi.

note.yi: 经文说「遇三冲」，注写「年月日二建冲者」：年、月、日是三处，「二建」的「二」按上下文可能是「三」的误字，也可能指月建、日建两处，书里没有说明，译文照写。
note.en: The verse says 'meeting three clashes' and the commentary 'clashed by the two rulers of Year, Month and Day': the Year, Month and Day make three, so the 'two' of 'two rulers' may by context be a mis-write of 'three', or may mean the Month and Day rulers, which the book does not explain; the translation follows the text.

units.title: 玄武主阴虚黑缩、勾陈应胀闷黄浮：玄武临官爻或忌神及阴虚之症，防缩浆黑陷；勾陈附鬼爻，主胀闷黄浮

rule.yi: 玄武主阴虚、痘色发黑收缩，勾陈应验为胀闷、面色发黄浮肿。玄武带官爻，或带忌神，以及阴虚的症候，要防浆水收缩、痘色发黑塌陷；勾陈如果附在鬼爻上，主胀闷、发黄、浮肿。
rule.en: The Dark Tortoise means yin deficiency, blackened and shrunken pox; the Hook Earth responds with swelling, oppression and a yellow, puffy look. If the Dark Tortoise sits on the Pressure line, or on the Adversary, or in a condition of yin deficiency, guard against the fluid shrinking and the pox turning black and sunken; if the Hook Earth clings to the Pressure line, it means swelling, oppression, yellowness and puffiness.

zh: 玄武主阴虚黑缩，勾陈应胀闷黄浮
yi: 玄武主阴虚、痘色发黑收缩，勾陈应验为胀闷、面色发黄浮肿
en: The Dark Tortoise means yin deficiency, blackened and shrunken pox; the Hook Earth responds with swelling, oppression and a yellow, puffy look

zh: 玄武临官爻，或临忌神及阴虚之症，防缩浆黑陷；
勾陈如附鬼爻，主胀闷黄浮。
yi: 玄武带官爻，或带忌神，以及阴虚的症候，要防浆水收缩、痘色发黑塌陷；
勾陈如果附在鬼爻上，主胀闷、发黄、浮肿。
en: If the Dark Tortoise sits on the Pressure line, or on the Adversary, or in a condition of yin deficiency, guard against the fluid shrinking and the pox turning black and sunken;
if the Hook Earth clings to the Pressure line, it means swelling, oppression, yellowness and puffiness.

units.title: 螣蛇木摆似惊风、朱雀火炎真血热：螣蛇临木爻官鬼，初起未见点时似惊风；官鬼属火又临朱雀，是血热火毒之症，须用大黄黄连清火泻毒，迟服则痘隐焦黑不能挽回

rule.yi: 螣蛇带木摆动像惊风，朱雀带火炽盛是真的血热。螣蛇带着木爻的官鬼，主刚开始还没见到痘点的时候，像是惊风；如果卦中官鬼属火，又带朱雀，是血热火毒的症候，必须用大黄、黄连这类药，一定要清火泻毒才能得救；如果服得迟，病势更猛，痘隐没下去、焦黑，没法挽回。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake with Wood swaying is like infantile convulsions; the Vermilion Bird with blazing Fire is truly blood heat. If the Coiling Snake sits on a Wood Pressure line, before the spots are yet seen at the beginning it seems like infantile convulsions; if in the hexagram the Pressure line is Fire and sits on the Vermilion Bird, it is a condition of blood heat and fire poison, and one must use rhubarb, coptis and the like: only by clearing fire and draining poison can there be rescue; if it is taken late the enemy is fiercer, the pox sink out of sight and turn scorched and black, and it cannot be retrieved.

zh: 螣蛇木摆似惊风，朱雀火炎真血热
yi: 螣蛇带木摆动像惊风，朱雀带火炽盛是真的血热
en: The Coiling Snake with Wood swaying is like infantile convulsions; the Vermilion Bird with blazing Fire is truly blood heat

zh: 螣蛇临木爻官鬼，主初起未见点时似乎惊风；
若卦中官鬼属火，又临朱雀，是血热火毒之症，须用大黄、黄莲等剂，必清火泻毒方能有救，如迟服则敌甚，痘隐焦黑，不能挽回也。
yi: 螣蛇带着木爻的官鬼，主刚开始还没见到痘点的时候，像是惊风；
如果卦中官鬼属火，又带朱雀，是血热火毒的症候，必须用大黄、黄连这类药，一定要清火泻毒才能得救；如果服得迟，病势更猛，痘隐没下去、焦黑，没法挽回。
en: If the Coiling Snake sits on a Wood Pressure line, before the spots are yet seen at the beginning it seems like infantile convulsions;

if in the hexagram the Pressure line is Fire and sits on the Vermilion Bird, it is a condition of blood heat and fire poison, and one must use rhubarb, coptis and the like: only by clearing fire and draining poison can there be rescue; if it is taken late the enemy is fiercer, the pox sink out of sight and turn scorched and black, and it cannot be retrieved.

note.yi: 「黄莲」是「黄连」的误字。「惊风」是小儿抽搐一类的急症。这一条说火鬼带朱雀要用大黄、黄连清火泻毒，而前面医药章有「火鬼旺宜大寒药」的说法（见 LY.ILL.HJC.82、LY.ILL.HJC.84），增删卜易的李我平驳「火鬼忌热水鬼忌寒」是拘泥（LY.ILL.ZS.40）；这一条是痘疹专门的用药，不是一般病的通则。
note.en: 'Huang lian' written with the lotus character is a mis-write of coptis. 'Jingfeng' is infantile convulsions and the like, an acute illness. This entry says a Fire Pressure line on the Vermilion Bird needs rhubarb and coptis to clear fire and drain poison, while the earlier chapter on medicine has the saying that a strong Fire ghost suits very cold medicines (see LY.ILL.HJC.82 and LY.ILL.HJC.84), and Li Woping in the Zengshan Buyi rejects 'Fire Pressure fears heat, Water Pressure fears cold' as rigid (LY.ILL.ZS.40); this entry is medicine specific to pox, not a general rule for illness.

units.title: 白虎同忌煞交重哭声将至：白虎临忌神发动克伤用神，又无原神持护，立见其危

rule.yi: 白虎和忌神、煞神一起交重（发动），哭声将要到来：白虎带着忌神发动，克伤用神，又没有原神来扶持保护的，马上就出现危险。
rule.en: The White Tiger together with the Adversary and killing spirits all moving means the sound of wailing is coming: if the White Tiger sits on the Adversary and it moves to control and wound the Subject, and there is no Support to hold and protect it, danger appears at once.

zh: 白虎同忌煞交重，哭声将至
yi: 白虎和忌神、煞神一起交重，哭声将要到来
en: The White Tiger together with the Adversary and killing spirits all moving: the sound of wailing is coming

zh: 白虎临忌神发动克伤用神，又无原神持护者，立见其危。
yi: 白虎带着忌神发动，克伤用神，又没有原神来扶持保护的，马上就出现危险。
en: If the White Tiger sits on the Adversary and it moves to control and wound the Subject, and there is no Support to hold and protect it, danger appears at once.

note.yi: 「哭声将至」是说要死人了；书里没有直接写死，本库照字面译。
note.en: 'The sound of wailing is coming' means a death is near; the book does not write the word death, and the library follows the text.

units.title: 青龙会恩星发动庆贺齐来：青龙临原神发动，生合用神，痘必收功

rule.yi: 青龙会合恩星发动，庆贺的人一起到来：青龙带着原神发动，生合用神，痘一定能收功。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon meeting the kindly star and moving means congratulations arrive together: if the Azure Dragon sits on the Support and it moves to generate and combine with the Subject, the pox will surely come to completion.

zh: 青龙会恩星发动，庆贺齐来
yi: 青龙会合恩星发动，庆贺的人一起到来
en: The Azure Dragon meeting the kindly star and moving: congratulations arrive together

zh: 青龙临原神发动，生合用神，痘必收功也。
yi: 青龙带着原神发动，生合用神，痘一定能收功。
en: If the Azure Dragon sits on the Support and it moves to generate and combine with the Subject, the pox will surely come to completion.

note.yi: 经文的「恩星」注里没有解释，从注文看就是原神。这一条和上一条（白虎同忌）是一对：一个是白虎带忌神，一个是青龙带原神。
note.en: The verse's 'kindly star' is not explained in the commentary and from the commentary it is the Support. This entry and the previous (the White Tiger with the Adversary) are a pair: one is the White Tiger on the Adversary, the other the Azure Dragon on the Support.

units.title: 定死活于五行生克之中、决轻重于六神临持之上：生死全凭五行生克的轻重，兼看六神，此节乃一章之大旨

rule.yi: 生死取决于五行生克之中，轻重取决于六神落在哪里、带在谁身上。生死全靠生克的轻重，再兼看六神，这一节是全章的大旨。
rule.en: Life and death are settled within the generating and controlling of the five phases, and light or heavy is decided by where the six spirits sit and what they hold. Life and death rest wholly on the weight of generating and controlling, together with a look at the six spirits; this passage is the main purpose of the whole chapter.

zh: 定死活于五行生克之中，决轻重于六神临持之上
yi: 生死取决于五行生克之中，轻重取决于六神落在哪里、带在谁身上
en: Life and death are settled within the generating and controlling of the five phases, and light or heavy is decided by where the six spirits sit and what they hold

zh: 生死全凭生克轻重，兼看六神，此节乃一章之大旨也。
yi: 生死全靠生克的轻重，再兼看六神，这一节是全章的大旨。
en: Life and death rest wholly on the weight of generating and controlling, together with a look at the six spirits; this passage is the main purpose of the whole chapter.

zh: 儿孙满目未出花，耽许多忧虑；
金玉满堂失教训，枉费尽心机。
yi: 儿孙满眼，都还没有出花，耽误了多少忧虑；
金玉满堂却缺了教导，白白费尽心机。
en: Children and grandchildren fill the eye and none has yet had the pox: much anxiety is spent;
a hall full of gold and jade but no instruction: all one's ingenuity wasted.

note.yi: 最后这一对句是全章的收尾，讲做父母的心事（儿孙还没出花时的忧虑，以及家里再富也要教导），不是断卦的规则。注文说的「六神」是螣蛇、朱雀、勾陈、白虎、青龙、玄武。
note.en: The last couplet closes the chapter and speaks of a parent's cares (the worry before the children have had the pox, and that however rich a household is it must still instruct); it is not a rule of judgment. The 'six spirits' of the commentary are the Coiling Snake, Vermilion Bird, Hook Earth, White Tiger, Azure Dragon and Dark Tortoise.
